plan_objective: State the outcome the approved plan is intended to achieve.
scope: Define what is in scope and explicitly out of scope.
tasks: Task 1 — include owner, dependency and expected output.
acceptance_criteria: Measurable criterion that will be verified after implementation.
dependencies: List required approvals, evidence or technical dependencies.
risks: List delivery, security, operational and rollback risks.
rollback_plan: Describe how to reverse or contain the change if acceptance criteria fail.
